findings.detail: The scene is new (bug-report labels instead of docstrings), but the correct answer is the same as in M1-S44-T1: a stratified random sample of high-confidence outputs. Option B reuses the earlier wrong option 'Track one overall acceptance rate for all docstrings'. Both rely on a single combined error rate across all segments. Option D also reuses the threshold-raising part of that same earlier wrong option. Replace B with a distractor that the earlier question did not use.

blind_answer.reason: Stratified random sampling within each component and field makes sure small segments such as mobile get enough reviewed labels to show their own error rate and reveal new error patterns. A uniform sample lets these segments disappear into the aggregate figure.
